connect_during_cut.error: psql: error: connection to server at "192.168.56.10", port 5432 failed: timeout expired

note: The holder kept an open versioned transaction (main's branch row locked) when the host-only link was unplugged and its client process died. The server ends such a session only through idle_in_transaction_session_timeout or when TCP declares the peer dead (server_settings: the values in effect for this TCP connection); with PostgreSQL's defaults that takes about 2 h 11 min. Polling starts when the link is back. main_locked_for_s is server time from the holder's last statement to the first poll that no longer finds the session (up to one 1 s poll late); if the session was already gone at the first reachable poll it is an upper bound, and when that poll came after the bound, bound_observable is false and bound_met is null. With --expect-gone-within the drill passes only if the server released main within that many seconds without the owner's pg_terminate_backend.
